def_en: 1) to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose
1a2) fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle)
kjv: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.
expl: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
etim: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from )
